description: This file defines the base class PdfResourceTable within the PdfSharp.Pdf.Advanced namespace, serving as a foundation for various resource tables like FontTable, ImageTable, and FormXObjectTable, managing document-wide resources for PDF processing.

classes.name: PdfResourceTable
classes.description: A base class for managing resource tables such as fonts, images, and form XObjects within a PDF document. It maintains a reference to the owner PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfResourceTable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource table with the owning PdfDocument. Throws an ArgumentNullException if the owner is null.
